records.purpose: as-built yield and ultimate strength for each qualified build orientation and heat-treatment condition
records.process_condition: same machine, parameters, orientation, heat treatment/HIP and finish as the passport context
records.acceptance_rule: lower confidence bound of measured yield per orientation >= admitted passport yield allowable, with n from the V5-04 prospective plan

minimum_specimens.reason: specimen count follows a prospective variance plan, not a copied constant

external_dependency.description: accredited tensile test laboratory capacity and specimen preparation route

records.purpose: as-built high-cycle fatigue endurance with the stated surface finish and service environment
records.process_condition: as-built surfaces of the stated finish class; environment per temperature_environment
records.acceptance_rule: measured run-out stress at the declared cycle count with a lower confidence bound >= admitted endurance allowable

acceptance_threshold.reason: fatigue allowable and cycle count not yet admitted

minimum_specimens.reason: staircase or S-N specimen count follows a prospective plan

external_dependency.description: fatigue test capacity in the declared environment

records.purpose: measured density bounds for the mass judge
records.process_condition: coupons from the same builds and heat treatment as the part
records.acceptance_rule: Archimedes density with expanded uncertainty recorded as passport density bounds

acceptance_threshold.reason: density requirement depends on the mass budget

minimum_specimens.reason: specimen count follows a prospective plan

external_dependency.description: calibrated balance and immersion fluid reference

records.purpose: defect population supporting the passport defect assumptions
records.process_condition: sections or CT of coupons from the same builds and heat treatment
records.acceptance_rule: measured porosity fraction and maximum pore size within the admitted defect assumption, with detection limit stated

minimum_specimens.reason: specimen count follows a prospective plan

external_dependency.description: metallography or CT access for coupons

records.purpose: per-finish-class Ra and the calibration of equivalent sand roughness ks against Ra
records.process_condition: each finish class used on a part face, at the relevant build angles
records.acceptance_rule: at least 3 calibration points per finish class spanning the Ra range, with the ks/Ra bounds and range admitted per class

acceptance_threshold.reason: ks calibration against flow data not yet available

minimum_specimens.reason: points per class follow a prospective plan; 3 is only the minimum the judge accepts

external_dependency.description: flow-derived equivalent sand roughness measurements for each finish class

records.purpose: dimensional accuracy and wall detectability of the CT metrology used for as-built checks
records.process_condition: calibration artifact scanned with the same scanner settings as parts
records.acceptance_rule: expanded dimensional accuracy from artifact, edge localization and repeatability meets the admitted requirement; voxel pitch alone is not accepted

acceptance_threshold.reason: dimensional accuracy requirement not yet admitted

minimum_specimens.reason: repeat scans follow a prospective plan

external_dependency.description: traceable calibration artifact and CT scanner access
